topic.symptom: The PC turns on (fans spin) but the monitor shows nothing.
topic.title: PC On, But No Picture? Check the Graphics Card's Power Cable

script: PC on, but no picture? Shut down and unplug it first. Find the power socket on the graphics card. Plug in its power cable from your PSU. If it has more than one, connect them all. Plug it back in. Then try booting again.

storyboard.title: PC On, But No Picture? Check the Graphics Card's Power Cable
storyboard.narrationStyle: Calm, conversational, one check. The captions are burned into the cut; no voice generated.

beats.visualDirection: The stylized PC lit, its fans turning; the camera pushes in on the monitor beside it, which stays dark.

beats.narration: Shut down and unplug it first.
beats.visualDirection: At the back of the power supply, the power cord comes out of the inlet.

beats.narration: Find the power socket on the graphics card.
beats.visualDirection: The side panel slides off; the camera closes on an empty power socket on the graphics card's top edge in an example position, outlined amber, marked POSITION VARIES.

beats.narration: Plug in its power cable from your PSU.
beats.visualDirection: Side view: the plug marked GPU lowers onto the socket, thumbs press it home, its latch hooks over the tab.

beats.narration: If it has more than one, connect them all.
beats.visualDirection: The plug outlined green; CHECK YOUR CARD'S MANUAL below.
beats.onScreenText: FULLY IN → CHECK YOUR CARD'S MANUAL

beats.visualDirection: The camera pulls back from the filled socket; the panel slides back on; at the back, the cord goes back in.
The unlit PC beside the dark monitor, its power button pulsing amber. No one presses it; no boot is shown.

factualGuardrails: Never say: guaranteed cure for boot failures (It may not work; one check, never a guaranteed fix.)
Never say: one universal connector type fits all graphics cards (Cards use different connectors (6+2-pin, 12V-2x6 and others); the cut says CHECK YOUR CARD'S MANUAL.)
Never say: any modular lead swaps freely between different PSU brands (Modular cables can differ between brands, series and models.)
Never say: successfully boots straight into Windows afterwards (The cut ends before anyone presses the button; no boot is shown or promised.)
persistentDisclosures: Stylized example · not a fix for every PC

claims.proposition: unplug the power cable before working inside the PC
claims.basis: Crucial, "How to Install Memory in Your Desktop" (https://www.crucial.com/support/install-memory-desktop): "Shut down your system. Once your system has been powered off, unplug the power cable." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: a graphics card's power comes from its own cables from the power supply
claims.basis: Corsair, "Can I use a PCI-e cable in the 8-pin motherboard plug?" (https://www.corsair.com/us/en/explorer/diy-builder/power-supply-units/can-i-use-a-pci-e-cable-in-the-8-pin-motherboard-plug/): "The connectors are either labelled as PCIe or CPU. The PCIe cables go to your graphics card, and the cable marked CPU will mount in your motherboards 8-pin header." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: check the card's power connectors are properly connected, all of them where a card has several
claims.basis: Intel, "Intel Arc A750 not working (Intel Community support thread)" (https://community.intel.com/t5/Intel-ARC-Graphics/Intel-Arc-A750-Not-Working/m-p/1484315): "Search-excerpt summary: Intel's support reply says to ensure the power connectors are properly connected to the power supply and the graphics card." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it. Also: ASUS, "[Motherboard] Troubleshooting - No Power/No Boot/No Display (FAQ 1042632)" (https://www.asus.com/us/support/faq/1042632/): "Search-excerpt summary: for a discrete graphics card with a power connector, make sure the connector is firmly seated; reseat the card and the display cable." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: a PC that is on with no picture can come down to the graphics card's power cables
claims.basis: NZXT, "PC Powers On But No Display: How to Fix It" (https://nzxt.com/blogs/news/pc-powers-on-but-no-display): "Search-excerpt summary: if the screen stays black, reseat the graphics card and its PCIe power cables at both the card and the PSU." Checked 2026-10-12 via search excerpts; the factual-takeaway gate re-reads it.

claims.proposition: use the power supply's own cable
claims.basis: Seasonic, "Which cables are compatible with my Power Supply?
